question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. When the fish, at last, had been safely landed, I asked the brothers if they ate fish.

B. The condition that I put was that they had to help me land another fish for my men.

C. On receiving their eager answer that they most certainly did, I told them I would give them the fish we had just landed.

D. To this they readily agreed and the wait started again.
solution:
The correct answer is **"ACBD"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the correct sequence of the passage.
 
• **Statement A** is the **opening sentence** of the passage which explains the theme of the passage what happened when the narrator landed and his worry about the fish.
 
• **Statement C** is **the second sentence** of the passage.
 
• **Statement B** is the** third sentence** of the passage which explains the deal and how they agreed to the narrator's condition.
 
• **Statement D** is the **last sentence** of the passage and also an extensive portion of the previous statement that the condition made by the narrator.​

​Hence, the correct sequence is** A, C, B, D**

The correct passage is**:** **A.** When the fish, at last, had been safely landed, I asked the brothers if they ate fish. **C.** On receiving the eager answer that they most certainly did, I told them I would give them the fish we had just landed. **B.** The condition that I put was that they had to help me land another fish for my men. **D.** To this they readily agreed and the wait started again.
